name: KEEMING
recent: Kee Ming 近期获得一份价值 RM44.17 million 的 Puncak Alam 数据中心电气工程分包合约，并公布 1H27 净利同比增长三倍至 RM14.48 million。公司于 2026 年 8 月 27 日召开第一届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。
notable: 获得价值 RM44.17 million 的 Puncak Alam 数据中心电气工程分包合约。
1H27 净利同比增长三倍至 RM14.48 million。
2026 年 8 月 27 日召开第一届常年股东大会，所有决议获通过。
risks: 独立非执行董事 Ooi Guan Hoe 于 2026 年 9 月 21 日及 23 日分别出售 50,000 股普通股。
独立非执行董事 Susie Chung Kim Lan 于 2026 年 9 月 23 日出售 50,000 股普通股。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 RM48.4 million，净利为 RM6.447 million，净利率 13.3%；营收环比增长 15.6%，净利环比增长 6.1%，净利率较上季的 14.5% 有所下降。

recent_en: Kee Ming recently secured a RM44.17 million electrical works subcontract for a data centre in Puncak Alam and reported 1H27 net profit tripling year-on-year to RM14.48 million. The company held its First Annual General Meeting on 27 August 2026, where all resolutions were passed.
notable_en: Secured a RM44.17 million electrical works subcontract for a data centre in Puncak Alam.
1H27 net profit tripled year-on-year to RM14.48 million.
Held its First Annual General Meeting on 27 August 2026; all resolutions were passed.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Ooi Guan Hoe disposed of 50,000 ordinary shares on 21 September 2026 and another 50,000 on 23 September 2026.
Independent Non-Executive Director Susie Chung Kim Lan disposed of 50,000 ordinary shares on 23 September 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM48.4 million and net income was RM6.447 million, with a net margin of 13.3%; revenue grew 15.6% QoQ and net income rose 6.1% QoQ, while net margin declined from 14.5% in the previous quarter.
